all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The federal government provides cash grants totaling $350 million a year to encourage exploration and development by mostly small and medium-sized oil and gas companies in Western Canada, estimated to generate $1 billion of extra investment and 15,000 jobs.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The program is expected to stimulate investment in the oil and gas sector, leading to job creation and economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The federal government provides cash grants totaling $350 million a year.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: This initiative represents a significant investment in the startup ecosystem of the oil and gas sector, with potential for substantial economic impact through job creation and increased investment.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: Federal Government provides cash grants totalling $350 million a year to encourage exploration and development by mostly small and medium-sized oil and gas companies in Western Canada.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The description focuses on cash grants for exploration and development in the oil and gas sector, which does not align with R&D funding or knowledge transfer.
